name: agentos
description: Tiny, fast, Linux-compatible sandboxes. Powered by WebAssembly.

issues.title: Guest `node` ignores stdin as the program, and `node --input-type=module` reading stdin reports "command not found: node"
Docs validation gates reference the removed website/ directory and cannot run
Network permission rule sets never match; explicit permission objects also bypass the documented merge-over-default
Pi file-writing turn fails with Actor SQLite transaction timeout on local native runtime
Sidecar serializes all agent prompts per process: a second session's prompt cannot start until the active turn completes (across sessions and VMs)
ACP session dies mid-run: bufferedBytes saturates at whatever limits.acp ceiling is set (64 MiB and 256 MiB), with kilobytes of actual traffic
Add an awaited terminal cancellation API for ACP prompts

discussions.title: Any Updates on Self Hosting Docs?
Does the Rivetkit Cloudflare adapter use Durable Object KV or SQL?
Where is the `shutdown` function and `conn` property?
Does ActorCore on Cloudflare Workers support all features?

latest_release.name: v0.4.8
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(runtime): isolate AsyncLocalStorage between overlapping guest calls by @eersnington in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2094
* fix(runtime): add Uint8Array base64 and hex methods from TC39 proposal-arraybuffer-base64 by @eersnington in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2091
* docs: publish docs with the website's sync-repo script instead of a CI sync by @NathanFlurry in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2096
* fix(runtime): make node:v8 fail loudly on values JSON cannot keep by @eersnington in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2100
* fix(native-sidecar): keep guest SQLite inside the VM by @eersnington in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2098
* fix(client): accept limits.reactor so deadline hints name a settable option by @eersnington in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2102
* fix(runtime-core): stop killing a healthy sidecar when the host event loop stalls by @eersnington in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2099
* test(native-sidecar): classify assert/strict and new limit constants by @eersnington in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2103
* fix(native-sidecar): keep errno code on mount write errors and log failed exists by @eersnington in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2101
* fix(native-sidecar): stop retaining disposed VM filesystem snapshots by @eersnington in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2104
* fix(native-sidecar): give every VM shadow root a unique directory by @jasonkuhrt in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2093
* perf(fs): write a writeFiles batch in one sidecar request by @eersnington in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2105

## New Contributors
* @jasonkuhrt made their first contribution in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2093

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/compare/v0.4.7...v0.4.8
